about.summary: Each point is one 14 µm cell of a breast cancer tissue tile, embedded by the pathology foundation model Virchow2 and projected with UMAP. 19,328 cells from 302 tiles of 151 patients (21 hospitals). The same tiles are shown for Virchow2 and Phikon-v2. Hover a point to see its tile; the cell is marked on the tile grid.

sections.title: Source
items: BCSS (Breast Cancer Semantic Segmentation, Amgad et al. 2019): 151 regions of interest from TCGA-BRCA diagnostic slides (H&E, formalin-fixed), annotated pixel by pixel by pathologists and trainees.
Images are served by the BCSS slide server (demo.kitware.com/histomicstk); every tile is loaded from there when you hover, at the same pixels the model saw.
Clinical diagnosis from the NCI Genomic Data Commons (GDC), TCGA-BRCA.

sections.title: Tile selection
items: Regions resampled to 0.5 µm per pixel and cut into non-overlapping 224 × 224 px tiles (112 µm).
Tiles with at least 90 % annotated pixels are eligible; at most 2 per region are drawn at random (seed 0). No model output is used to choose tiles.

sections.title: Processing
items: Virchow2 (Paige; ViT-H/14 with 4 register tokens, self-supervised on whole-slide images), applied to each tile at 224 × 224 px (0.5 µm per pixel).
Patch tokens of 7 µm after the final layer norm, averaged 2 × 2 into a 8 × 8 grid of 14 µm cells (one point per cell).
UMAP with cosine distance, 30 neighbours, min_dist 0.1, random_state 0.

sections.title: Colour options (ground truth only)
items: tissue: pathologist annotation of the cell's pixels, majority class. Tumour includes ductal carcinoma in situ; 'immune infiltrate' is lymphocytic and plasma-cell infiltrate; 'unannotated' if less than half of the cell is annotated.

histotype: the patient's diagnosis in the pathology report (GDC primary_diagnosis). Lobular = 'Lobular carcinoma, NOS', ductal = 'Infiltrating duct carcinoma, NOS', other = any other or combined diagnosis. It describes the patient, not the cell.
hospital: TCGA tissue source site (characters 6-7 of the case id).

sections.title: Caveats
items: BCSS regions were chosen by annotators to contain tumour; they are not a random sample of the slide.
Only 5 lobular cases are in BCSS, so the histotype colouring says little about lobular vs ductal; see the TCGA-BRCA lobular vs ductal map for a balanced set.
UMAP distorts global distances; nearby points are similar, far-apart clusters are not necessarily dissimilar.
